article.story: ASHEVILLE, N.C. -- — De’Ante Green’s 21 points helped Tennessee Tech defeat UNC Asheville 98-77 on Wednesday. Green also added three steals for the Golden Eagles (4-2). Caleb Sanders scored 19 points and added six rebounds. Trent Mosquera had 14 points and shot 4 for 13, including 4 for 12 from beyond the arc. Khayri Dunn led the Bulldogs (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 24 points and seven assists. Connor Dubsky added 12 points and two steals for UNC Asheville. Ian Bailey finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
